title: Kundalini Threads
description: A silhouetted female figure stands in a mystical apothecary, her spine glowing with a coiled green serpent of light while orange flames rise from her head. She manipulates glowing red threads connected to floating orbs and symbols, surrounded by shelves of potions, scrolls, a large stained-glass rose window, and an open book displaying the number 8.
prompt: A silhouetted woman in a dark mystical study stands in profile, her spine illuminated by a glowing green kundalini serpent that spirals upward, orange flames rising from her head. She pulls glowing red threads that connect to floating orbs and symbols. Behind her are wooden shelves filled with potion bottles, scrolls, and hanging lanterns. A large colorful stained-glass rose window dominates the background. In the foreground is an ornate desk with an open book showing the number 8, a quill pen, and jewelry. The atmosphere is magical and esoteric with swirling energy.
